rationale: Two interleaved dispatches at this candidate measured processing-ratio 1.142 and 1.116 against the 10% budget (median 1.129 shown here). This is the CLI's forced per-line incremental dispatch of 7 new provider detectors from redact-secret#862-#868 (Anthropic api01/admin01 prefixes, an OpenAI admin-key contract fix, Amazon Bedrock long/short-term keys, ElevenLabs, Together AI, Tavily, and keyword-gated Mistral/Cohere/AI21/Deepgram coverage). Three rounds of optimization (redact-secret#870, #871, #872) cut the regression from an initial 13-31% down to this residual by removing an unconditional per-line table allocation, replacing a length-sensitive Boyer-Moore-Horspool scan with a faster first-byte scan, and removing a duplicate whole-input scan on single-line CLI input. The remaining cost is structural: rust-core's own scale-logs benchmark uses a one-shot scan() the CLI's stdin path never takes (it always streams per line, so a credential can straddle a chunk boundary), which amplifies each new detector's fixed per-line cost relative to that one-shot comparison. Closing it further needs a redesign of the incremental per-line dispatch path, tracked separately in redact-secret#883 and not committed to this or any specific release. Accepted for this candidate only; the budget definition is unchanged, and a later breach of this trigger at a different source commit is judged afresh.
